verdict.rationale: CrewAI Enterprise docs mention a 'Webhook Streaming' feature that streams real-time events/updates to external systems, but this is only a one-line bullet point under the paid Enterprise/AMP tier with no setup, subscription-model, or API documentation, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404s (no discoverable webhook API spec). Missing for 10: detailed webhook subscription/configuration docs, event schema/catalog, authentication/verification details, and independent/hands-on confirmation that this works as described.
